description: Professional 3D Developer Portfolio Website - Android & Full-Stack Web Developer

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
